name: Biennale of Sydney
known: Founded in 1973 by Franco Belgiorno-Nettis, then co-managing director of the construction company Transfield.

2024: turnover of $19.6M in cash and in kind; the chair named the federal and NSW governments, the City of Sydney, Fondation Cartier, the Neilson Foundation and Mirvac as patrons (stated by the space).
Biennale of Sydney posts a report per edition for 2018 to 2024, files accounts with the ACNC, names main funders undated, and lists ten directors.

name: Museum of Contemporary Art Australia (MCA)
known: Lorraine Tarabay chairs the board and Suzanne Cotter has been director since January 2022 (Wikipedia;
Corporate: the chairman's foreword thanks Telstra, Qantas and Oceania Cruises.

name: TarraWarra Museum of Art
known: Founded by the philanthropists Eva Besen AO and Marc Besen AC, who gave the museum and about 600 works of Australian art from their collection.
On site: sculptures in the grounds, including Callum Morton's "Valhalla", and the TarraWarra Biennial, founded by Maudie Palmer in 2006 (Wikipedia).
Run by an independent board chaired by Daniel Besen AM.
Victoria Lynn is director (twma.com.au).

name: Buku-Larrnggay Mulka Centre
known: The centre names Binygurr Wirrpanda as Chair.

name: Kunsthaus Bregenz
known: Edelbert Köb was founding director until 2000.

name: Grazer Kunstverein
known: Early artistic directors were Peter Pakesch and Helmut Strobl (1986 to 1987), then Elisabeth Printschitz (1987 to 1993), Eva Maria Stadler (1994 to 2005), Søren Grammel (2005 to 2011), Krist Gruijthuijsen (2012 to 2016), Kate Strain (2016 to 2021) and Tom Engels (2021 to 2025).
Yana Foqué is now executive-artistic director (stated by the space).
Board: Georg Mayer-Heinisch (chairman), Alexander Isola (cashier), Stefan Stolitzka (secretary), Georg List, Katrin Bucher Trantow and Alois Kölbl.

name: HALLE FÜR KUNST Steiermark
known: Sandro Droschl, head of the Kunstverein Medienturm, has led it since 2013 (e-flux directory).

name: TAXISPALAIS Kunsthalle Tirol
known: Nina Tabassomi has been managing and artistic director since 2017.

name: Ars Electronica Center
known: Ars Electronica began as a festival in Linz in September 1979, founded by Hannes Leopoldseder, Hubert Bognermayr, Herbert W.
Gerfried Stocker has been artistic director since 2014 (Wikipedia).

name: Salzburger Kunstverein
known: About 900 members, around 700 of them artists, plus an international Advisory Circle that has informally supported the director since 2024 (the association's website).

Directors since 1992 per Wikipedia: Hildegund Amanshauser (1992), Silvia Eiblmayr (1993 to 1995), Amanshauser again (1996 to 2004), Hemma Schmutz (2005 to 2013), Séamus Kealy (2014 to March 2023) and Mirela Baciak from July 2023.
Residency programmes for artists, curators and writers, including a writer residency with ArtReview in 2026.

name: Domenig Steinhaus
known: Board: Wilfried Aichinger (chair, retired lawyer and consultant), Georg Wald (architect), Kristin Grasser (tax adviser) and Hartwig Wetschko (architect); co-opted members are the architects Christian Halm and Elke Knoess Grillitsch.

name: Albertina
known: Directors: Klaus Albrecht Schröder led it from 1999 to 2024.
Ralph Gleis has been director general since 1 January 2025 (German Wikipedia).
After the war the museum contested restitution claims for works by Klimt and Schiele, and its director called for a moratorium on claims (English Wikipedia).

name: Das Rote Wien im Waschsalon Karl-Marx-Hof
known: Opened on 1 May 2010 and curated by Lilli Bauer and Werner T.
The association, ZVR 988113764, has a six-member board chaired by Wolfgang Maderthaner.
Run by Verein Sammlung Rotes Wien (ZVR 988113764), chaired by Wolfgang Maderthaner.
Names its six-member board, curators, guides and partner logos on its site.
